import io,sys

KIT_NEW = '''/** Barrier that slides along X and holds at both ends of its travel. */
export const slidingWall = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  speed: number,
  distance: number,
  pauseSeconds = 0,
  y = 0.8,
  h = 1.6,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'sliding-wall',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, h, 0.5),
  motion: { kind: 'translate', axis: v(1, 0, 0), speed, distance, loop: 'ping-pong', pauseSeconds },
});

/** Door that swings the lane open, waits, then closes again. */
export const door = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  speed: number,
  distance: number,
  pauseSeconds = 0.6,
  y = 0.85,
  h = 1.6,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'door',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, h, 0.4),
  motion: { kind: 'translate', axis: v(1, 0, 0), speed, distance, loop: 'ping-pong', pauseSeconds },
});

/** Weight swinging across the lane on a fixed arm. */
export const pendulum = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  armLength: number,
  speed: number,
  swingAngle = 0.9,
  y = 1.5,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'pendulum',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(0.5, armLength * 1.3, 0.5),
  motion: { kind: 'swing', axis: v(0, 0, 1), speed, armLength, swingAngle },
});

/** Entry volume that drops the ball back onto the course at `exit`. */
export const teleporter = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  exit: Vec3,
  diameter = 1.4,
  exitVelocityScale = 0.7,
  y = 0.4,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'teleporter',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(diameter, 1.2, diameter),
  exit,
  exitVelocityScale,
});

/** Strip that accelerates the ball along `direction` while it rolls over it. */
export const boostPad = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sz: number,
  strength: number,
  maxSpeed = 15,
  direction = v(0, 0, 1),
  y = 0.3,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'boost-pad',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, 1, sz),
  direction,
  strength,
  maxSpeed,
});

/** Pad that kicks the ball straight up, then needs a moment to recharge. */
export const jumpPad = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sz: number,
  strength: number,
  cooldownSeconds = 0.4,
  y = 0.3,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'jump-pad',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, 1, sz),
  strength,
  cooldownSeconds,
});

/** Volume with its own gravity pull, defaults to straight down. */
export const gravityZone = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sy: number,
  sz: number,
  strength: number,
  direction = v(0, -1, 0),
  y = sy / 2,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'gravity-zone',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, sy, sz),
  strength,
  direction,
});

/** Volume that pulls the ball towards its centre, or pushes it away when `repel`. */
export const magnetZone = (
  id: string,
  x: number,
  z: number,
  sx: number,
  sy: number,
  sz: number,
  strength: number,
  repel = false,
  y = 0.9,
): ObstacleDescriptor => ({
  id,
  type: 'magnet-zone',
  transform: { position: v(x, y, z) },
  size: v(sx, sy, sz),
  strength,
  repel,
});

'''
